newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean banking sector net up sharply in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Chilean banking sector net up sharply in Q1.

text.p: Chile's banking sector reported 66.37 billion pesos in net earnings in the first quarter of the year, up from 55.45 billion pesos in the first quarter of 1996, the Banking Superintendecy reported.

It reported the sector's total outstanding loans at 19.1 trillion pesos and total capital and reserves at 2.1 trillion pesos in the first quarter. No comparative figures were available for those numbers.
The sector's annualized return on capital and reserves was an average 13.7 percent in the first quarter, said the Superintendency in its monthly figures on banks and financial institutions.
The most profitable bank in the first quarter was Banco de Chile at 16.7 billion pesos, followed by Banco del Estado at 8.5 billion pesos and Banco Santiago at 8.3 billion pesos.

In terms of outstanding loans, Banco Santiago was number one in the first quarter at 3.2 trillion pesos, followed by Banco Santander-Chile at 2.4 trillion pesos and Banco de Chile at 2.3 trillion pesos.
